assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished transparent isolated 2D game item illustration for the Korean office-fantasy card roguelike DualJob. Art direction to match existing game assets: chunky dark plum outlines, hand-painted cel shading, saturated jewel colors, warm cream highlights, slightly mischievous storybook fantasy office objects. Square composition, one compact object centered and fully visible with generous clear padding on all sides, strong simple silhouette; small inventory relic icon. No card frame, no text, no letters, no numerals, no watermark, no backdrop, no ground plane. Clear silhouette at 48px wide, simplified details, few ornaments. All background genuinely transparent, no checkerboard drawn. Each object belongs to a single cohesive illustration. Subject: a small golden treasure case with crown-shaped latch opening to reveal a luminous rose heart and three gold coins, teal velvet lining
